summary: ADR 0095 adds git_status, git_diff, and git_log as read-only tools behind CONCHBASE_ENABLE_GIT_TOOLS. The provider maps to fixed argument vectors, runs with shell:false and cwd confinement, rejects absolute or escaping diff paths before spawning, caps output and timeout, and reports absent-binary or non-repository directories as bounded error codes. No write subcommand is reachable.
